# Test fixtures

- `compact-normal-state.json`: minimal normalized calculator state used by the golden compact-export test.
- `autoproposed-ug.json`: valid geometry-only UG export.
- `autoproposed-pco.json`: valid geometry-only PCO export for the Web-to-plugin contract.
- `autoproposed-multi-span.json`: mixed aerial, UG, geometry-only, movement and DG example.

Fixture heights and span lengths use integer inches in exported payloads.
